lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Second Monday. The room knows your name now, mostly. The coffee is the same coffee.

lines.name: MILES
lines.text: Poster's up by the cage. Biscayne Classic, Saturday, February fourteenth. Two hundred and twelve seats, three-forty to get in. Sign-up sheet's on the clipboard.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Eleven names on it already. The twelfth, in careful handwriting, is Mustich.

lines.name: MUSTICH
lines.text: Don't look so surprised. I've been studying this room for a year. You've been studying it for a week.

lines.name: MUSTICH
lines.text: I ran your bubble hands through my solver last night. Do you want to know what it said?
